Attempt 2 connected 82 groups in memory (multi-group nets 97 -> 95), then crashed at the save: AttributeError 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'replace'. Cause: repair.py's sweep loop stored the A* result in a variable named 'path', shadowing the board-path argument of the same name — after the final (failed) search the save used None. This also retro-explains attempt 1's loss (wrong-typed path at its save), superseding the concurrency theory recorded in 2add453. Fix: route variable renamed rpath, board path renamed board_path, output path computed before the sweeps, and the board is checkpoint-saved after EVERY sweep so no late failure can lose a whole run again. Lockfile kept as insurance. Repo board still the v5 board. Attempt 3 runs from this code
